ideas.pitch: A hyper-local carbon emissions tracking and offset marketplace specifically scoped to Oxford University colleges.

ideas.pitch: A graph intelligence platform that maps historical provenance, ownership networks, and acquisition trails of rare manuscripts in the Bodleian Library.
ideas.title: Bodleian Rare Book Provenance Graph
